metric_transforms.ma_alignment_score: daily MA alignment only: BULLISH=+1; MIXED=0; BEARISH=-1
metric_transforms.macd_score: (daily + 0.5*weekly + 0.25*monthly) / 1.75; single daily alignment gate is Mom20>0 and Mom60>0 and RS20>0 and RS60>0; each D/W/M BULLISH_CROSS=+1 only when the gate passes, otherwise 0; ABOVE_SIGNAL=+0.6, ON_SIGNAL=0, BELOW_SIGNAL=-0.6, BEARISH_CROSS=-1
metric_transforms.rsi_headroom: daily RSI14 only: 50<=RSI<=65 is +1; 40<=RSI<50 or 65<RSI<70 is +0.5; 30<=RSI<40 is 0; RSI>=70 is -0.5; RSI<30 is -0.25

scoring_method.macro_polarity: NEUTRAL defensive rotation: lower beta/vol and shallower drawdown score better
scoring_method.risk_standard_deviation: population standard deviation (ddof=0), scaled by sqrt(21)
scoring_method.kelly_method: beta-adjusted residual edge divided by tracking-error variance; quarter-Kelly capped at 5%
scoring_method.confidence_method: LOW for every ranked equity because only 2 of 4 factor families are available/supportive
scoring_method.driver_selection: For each metric, compute its signed Adj Score contribution: Tech 0.30*z/8*DQ; Macro 0.15*polarity_z/3*DQ with inverse beta/volatility and positive shallower-drawdown polarity. Publish the three largest positive and three largest negative sourceable metric contributions; append structural gaps and penalties separately.
scoring_method.max_family_conviction: max(abs(0.30*Tech_Z),abs(0.15*Macro_Z))/(abs(0.30*Tech_Z)+abs(0.15*Macro_Z)); available production families only; Fund_Z/Sent_Z are UNAVAILABLE and excluded from the denominator; values above 50% block threshold #3

production_status_reasons: Fund_Z/Sent_Z unavailable; no name has 3/4 families
Required-input completeness is 100%; DQ 0.80 reflects Enhancing gaps
all ranked names fail max-family-50% or other investability gates
